questions.question:
After interchanging the given two signs what will be the values of expression (I) and (II) respectively?

× and +

I. 5 × 12 - 15 + 20 ÷ 25

II. 36 + 3 × 2 - 15 ÷ 5
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation I. 5 × 12 - 15 + 20 ÷ 25

Now, if '× and +' are interchanged, then:

⇒ 5 + 12 - 15 × __**20 ÷ 25**__

⇒ 5 + 12 - __**15 × 0.8**__

⇒ __**5 + 12**__ - 12

⇒ __17 - 12__ = 5.

Given equation II: 36 + 3 × 2 - 15 ÷ 5

Now, if '× and +' are interchanged, then:

⇒ 36 × 3 + 2 - __**15 ÷ 5**__

⇒ __**36 × 3**__ + 2 - 3

⇒ __**108 + 2**__ - 3

⇒ __110 - 3__ = 107.

Here, the correct values are '5 and 107'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: A cube is painted on all surfaces with orange color and is divided into 27 equal cubes. How many cubes will have only one face painted?
questions.solution:
Given,

A cube is painted Orange on all surfaces and then the cube cuts into 27 small cubes of equal part.

So, it has been cut into: 3 × 3 × 3.

Here, n = 3.

Now, using formula: (n - 2)² × 6

⇒ (n - 2)2 × 6

⇒ (3 - 2)2 × 6

⇒ 12 × 6

⇒ 1 × 6 = 6.

So, total '6' cubes will have only one face painted.

Hence, the correct answer is **"6"**.
